symbols.name: input vector
symbols.meaning: The complex vector $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ whose transform is taken.
symbols.quote: Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ be a complex vector of length $q$, its number of entries; here $u$ is not the first input of earlier pages.

symbols.name: vector length
symbols.meaning: The length of $u$, which counts the entries of $u$ and of its transform.
symbols.quote: Let $u=(u_0,\dots,u_{q-1})$ be a complex vector of length $q$, its number of entries; here $u$ is not the first input of earlier pages.

symbols.name: primitive root of unity
symbols.meaning: The number $\exp(-2\pi i/q)$, a primitive $q$-th root of unity, so that $\omega^q=1$.
symbols.quote: Let $\omega=\exp(-2\pi i/q)$, the [primitive $q$-th root of unity](roots-of-unity.md), so $\omega^q=1$.

symbols.name: transform of u
symbols.meaning: The transform of $u$, the vector whose $k$-th entry is $\frac1q\sum_j u_j\omega^{jk}$.
symbols.quote: Let $\hat u$ be the transform of $u$, whose $k$-th entry $\hat u_k$ is given below, with $j$ and $k$ running over the entries of $u$ and $\hat u$, from $0$ to $q-1$:

symbols.name: transform index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of the transform $\hat u$, running from $0$ to $q-1$.
symbols.quote: Let $\hat u$ be the transform of $u$, whose $k$-th entry $\hat u_k$ is given below, with $j$ and $k$ running over the entries of $u$ and $\hat u$, from $0$ to $q-1$:

symbols.name: input index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of $u$, running from $0$ to $q-1$.
symbols.quote: Let $\hat u$ be the transform of $u$, whose $k$-th entry $\hat u_k$ is given below, with $j$ and $k$ running over the entries of $u$ and $\hat u$, from $0$ to $q-1$:

symbols.name: convolution index
symbols.meaning: The index of an entry of the cyclic convolution $c$, running from $0$ to $q-1$.
symbols.quote: Their product has degree below $q$, so reducing it modulo $x^q-1$ changes nothing, and its coefficients are the cyclic convolution $c$, where $c_l=\sum_{i+j\equiv l \ (\mathrm{mod}\ q)} a_i b_j$.

symbols.name: even-entry transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized transform, of length $q/2$, of the even-indexed entries of $u$.
symbols.quote: It splits $u$ into its even- and odd-indexed entries, transforms each at length $q/2$ (normalized results $\alpha$ and $\beta$), and combines them for $0\le k<q/2$, using $\omega^{q/2}=-1$:

symbols.name: odd-entry transform
symbols.meaning: The normalized transform, of length $q/2$, of the odd-indexed entries of $u$.
symbols.quote: It splits $u$ into its even- and odd-indexed entries, transforms each at length $q/2$ (normalized results $\alpha$ and $\beta$), and combines them for $0\le k<q/2$, using $\omega^{q/2}=-1$:

symbols.name: operation count
symbols.meaning: The number of operations the transform takes on a vector of length $q$.
symbols.quote: Let $T(q)$ count the operations on length $q$.

relations.quote: It matters because it turns [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md) into entrywise products.
